options: I'm the anonymous Chief of the MBCC.

The words Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control on your ID make his face pale visibly. Although he may not fully believe your identity, his attitude clearly becomes more cautious.

steps.speaker: Simon

He tries to hide his phone, but you hold onto it firmly and point the sharp Gray Mirror icon on the screen at him. Simon tries to dodge fearfully, but the man can't even muster the strength to break free from you now, the vigor he demonstrated online vanished completely.

steps.content: Tell me about Gray Mirror and the vote on it. You must know what it really means.

steps.speaker: Simon

steps.speaker: Simon

The Hidden Crisis of Gray Mirror. The Internet Will Swallow You Whole. True Stories of Devoured Anonymous Users on Sinister App. Emerging Social App and Real-Life Disappearance Cases.

The video's resolution is rather low, but you can still make out several pixelated tentacles tearing open a rift between virtuality and reality, emerging from within.
This abstract force is still almost unknown to Eastsiders. Even you haven't seen it in this form before, but a familiar voice precedes rationality in your mind...
It's a brand new form of Mania contamination. This is a Corruptor.
